author: Cleo Abram
description:
If you dug a hole into Saturn, the first thing you'd realize is most of it isn't solid!

It's got a frigid atmosphere of hydrogen and helium with icy ammonia clouds with winds that are about 4 times faster than the strongest hurricane winds on earth! As we fall deeper into its layers, we discover more new and other-worldly things along the way...

If you want optimistic science and tech stories, subscribe for more of our show HUGE* If True!

#animation #science #space #saturn #digging
title: What If You Dove Into Saturn?
